mapper.sql:
analysis.user_id = #{request.userId} AND analysis.information_id = item.id AND analysis.snapshot_id = snapshot.id AND analysis.information_type = 'JOB' AND analysis.prompt_version_id = #{request.promptVersionId} AND analysis.analysis_definition_key = 'JOB_USER_RELEVANCE' AND analysis.analysis_purpose = 'USER_RELEVANCE' AND analysis.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND analysis.result_json IS NOT NULL AND analysis.relevance_score IS NOT NULL AND analysis.analysis_definition_version IN
#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item.id) FROM information_item item INNER JOIN job_information job ON job.information_id = item.id INNER JOIN information_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.information_id = item.id AND snapshot.version_no = item.current_version_no INNER JOIN information_analysis analysis ON

SELECT item.id AS information_id, snapshot.id AS snapshot_id, analysis.id AS analysis_id, analysis.analysis_definition_version, item.first_seen_time, snapshot.title, snapshot.content, snapshot.standardized_payload, analysis.result_json AS analysis_result, analysis.relevance_score AS ai_relevance_score FROM information_item item INNER JOIN job_information job ON job.information_id = item.id INNER JOIN information_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.information_id = item.id AND snapshot.version_no = item.current_version_no INNER JOIN information_analysis analysis ON
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_information_interaction interaction_core WHERE interaction_core.user_id = #{request.userId} AND interaction_core.information_id = item.id AND interaction_core.feedback_state = 'NOT_INTERESTED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_information_interaction interaction_core INNER JOIN user_job_disposition disposition ON disposition.interaction_id = interaction_core.id WHERE interaction_core.user_id = #{request.userId} AND interaction_core.information_id = item.id AND disposition.job_disposition = 'CONTACTED_NOT_SUITABLE' )
AND NOT ( LOCATE(#{keyword}, snapshot.title) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword}, COALESCE(snapshot.content, '')) > 0 OR LOCATE( #{keyword}, COALESCE( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( snapshot.standardized_payload, '$.job.companyName')), '')) > 0 )
ORDER BY item.first_seen_time DESC, item.id DESC, analysis.analysis_definition_version DESC, analysis.id DESC
